hotel_name: Super Hotel O Malviya Nagar Inn

positive_snippets:
Satisfactory experience in terms of affordable price for double bedded rooms.
Overall the place was quiet, clean and spacious for short term stay.
Staffs were helpful and considerate too.
Location could have been better as it's quite inside the residential area of Malviya Nagar, but autorickshaw and Metro service within walking distance.
Consult Google maps for accurate location.
Very good hotel affordable price staff also good 😊👍💯

Very nice Hotel 🏨 and so looking room
Help full sttap
negative_snippets: Faculty is very aggressive. They are asking for extra money inspite of booking. They threw out baggage outside and start fighting.

⚠️ Beware – Fake Hotel Listing!
I booked this hotel online through OYO and paid ₹1000 in advance. The listing promised a refund on cancellation. But when I reached the location, there was no hotel at all – it simply didn’t exist!

I immediately filed a complaint, but till now, I haven’t received any refund. This feels like a complete scam.
Do not trust this listing. Don’t waste your money like I did.
